message.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>We prove the existence of a family of slow-decay positive solutions of a supercritical elliptic equation with Hardy potential</jats:p><jats:p><jats:disp-formula><jats:graphic xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" orientation="portrait" mime-subtype="gif" mimetype="image" position="float" xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="S0013091513000588_Ueqn1" /></jats:disp-formula></jats:p><jats:p>and study the stability and oscillation properties of these solutions. We also show that if the equation on ℝ<jats:sup><jats:italic>N</jats:italic></jats:sup> has a stable slow-decay positive solution, then for any smooth compact <jats:italic>K</jats:italic> ⊂ ℝ<jats:sup><jats:italic>N</jats:italic></jats:sup> a family of the exterior Dirichlet problems in  ℝ<jats:sup><jats:italic>N</jats:italic></jats:sup> \ <jats:italic>K</jats:italic> admits a continuum of stable slow-decay infinite-energy solutions.</jats:p>
title: Existence, Stability and Oscillation Properties of Slow-Decay Positive Solutions of Supercritical Elliptic Equations with Hardy Potential
